subject.title: Feature Request: Add custom client display name for TUI

question: Should `openclaw tui` expose a user-controlled Gateway client display name, and should that surface be a CLI-only flag, a persisted config setting, or an auto-derived label?
rationale: This adds public CLI/config-adjacent behavior and changes Gateway-visible presence metadata, so automation should not choose naming, persistence, or privacy defaults without maintainer intent.

options.title: Add CLI-only opt-in flag
options.body: Add a bounded `openclaw tui --client-name <name>` path for Gateway mode only, keeping the existing default for all current users.

options.title: Add persisted TUI config
options.body: Add a `tui` config key if maintainers want a stable per-user default, with schema, docs, and no upgrade surprise for existing users.

options.title: Defer or decline
options.body: Keep `openclaw-tui` as the fixed label until a broader TUI identity and privacy policy is chosen.

recommendation.title: Add CLI-only opt-in flag
recommendation.body: Add a bounded `openclaw tui --client-name <name>` path for Gateway mode only, keeping the existing default for all current users.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision is public CLI/product shape and privacy semantics, and steipete has both the current-label history and recent TUI CLI/docs ownership signal.
